title: AutoEval-Video: An Automatic Benchmark for Assessing Large Vision Language Models in Open-Ended Video Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Instructing annotators to devise questions that require the consideration of multiple frames and invalidating questions that can be answered using only a single oracle frame.
Having human annotators attempt to answer the video-based questions without viewing the actual videos to ensure the correct answer cannot be guessed from the text alone.
Creating a specific test set of incorrect responses generated by GPT-4V to check if the GPT-4 automated evaluator exhibits favoritism or bias toward outputs produced by its own model family.
